items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: New Orleans and I had Kenny Davern - Johnny Giuffrida, Chuck Folds, Ed Hubble, Buzzy Drootin, I had a fantastic band

ctx.x: New Orleans and I had Kenny Davern - Johnny Giuffrida, Chuck Folds, Ed Hubble, Buzzy Drootin, I had a fantastic band and it was against - there were two bands - there were the Dukes of Dixie Land and ourselves and it was a hell of a job and the leader got a nice big room - and everything and we stayed there about three weeks or four weeks with a promise to come back - with a lot of money. We never went back, because they changed the policy. You know, and these are the kind of things I was up against

all the time and this is why I started to rent myself out, calling the booking offices and saying - look, I don't have a band together, if you want me to put a band together I will, but why can't you put me with somebody - which they did and they started to do that.
